source_clause: ICE5.1) If SYNC is ON, adjusting driver temperature affects passenger temperature, adjusting passenger temperature would break SYNC and turn it off. Change temperature on climate screen by using arrows (move 1 increment up/ down per press, long press = fast move or slider (TEMP pop-up next to slider when touching it so that finger does not cover number). Long press = fast move shall also work for temperature HARD CONTROLS . The system can jump to a value as well via the slider or voice command. User must press slider handle to move temperature slider position; if user initially presses slider area outside of handle, ignore the press. The system can jump to a value as well via a slider bar touch or voice command. The user can also press slider handle to move temperature slider position; if user initially presses slider area outside of handle (i.e. to the left or right of the slider handle), ignore the press.
reasoning: 驗證目標：16.6.1（ICE5.1）定出 SYNC 之溫度連動與中斷、三種調整途徑、長按快移、以及滑桿把手之按壓判定，五個 037 leaf 對應之，一葉一 TC（§8.2.1）。關鍵情境條件：EMEA 軸取正向值（16.2，R-C29 併入 spec_ref）；依 **R-C34** 第十三軸全數補，第九軸全數補（五條之可觀察量皆在 head unit 之 climate screen），第十二軸不補；`-01`／`-02` 另補第二軸（SYNC 於單區不顯示，出處 16.11）。為什麼這樣切：`-01`（連動）與 `-02`（中斷）為 SYNC 之兩個相反方向，可各自獨立失效；`-04` 之長按快移同時適用畫面箭頭與**硬鍵**，其失效與 `-03` 之途徑列舉無關。刻意略過：**ICE5.1 把滑桿把手規則寫了兩次**（`User must press slider handle…` 與 `The user can also press slider handle…`，後者多一個括號說明），037 只給一個 leaf（`-05`），故一葉一 TC 不因條文重複而拆；**`voice command` 照錄於 `-03` 之 test_item 而不入 procedure** —— 語音辨識之觸發方式本節未定義，寫入即造值（§8.4.1）。

interface_axis_review.observable_interface: ICS climate screen 之溫度箭頭、滑桿與其把手、TEMP popup
interface_axis_review.axis_9: 暴露 → 全數補（五條之可觀察量皆為 climate screen 上之控制）
interface_axis_review.emea_ics: **不適用（反向）** —— 取正向軸值 PC，出處 16.2

tcs.tc_title: Driver temperature drives passenger temperature when synced
tcs.test_item: If SYNC is ON, adjusting the driver temperature shall affect the passenger temperature
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not a single zone climate configuration, for which Sync is not shown (16.11)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn SYNC on from the climate screen
2. Adjust the driver temperature
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "SYNC" button is highlighted
2. The passenger temperature follows the driver temperature
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.test_item: Adjusting the passenger temperature shall break SYNC and turn it off
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not a single zone climate configuration, for which Sync is not shown (16.11)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Turn SYNC on from the climate screen
2. Adjust the passenger temperature
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "SYNC" button is highlighted
2. The "SYNC" button is no longer highlighted
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Temperature changes by arrows and by slider
tcs.test_item: The user shall be able to change the temperature on the climate screen by using arrows or the slider, and the system shall be able to jump to a value via the slider or voice command
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the temperature up arrow on the climate screen
2. Touch the slider handle and drag it to another value
tcs.expected_result:
1. The temperature moves 1 increment up
2. The temperature follows the slider handle, and a TEMP pop-up is shown next to the slider
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Long press moves the temperature fast on screen and hard control
tcs.test_item: Long press shall be a fast move, and shall also work for temperature HARD CONTROLS
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press and hold the temperature up arrow on the climate screen
2. Press and hold the temperature hard control in the up direction
tcs.expected_result:
1. The temperature moves up by more than 1 increment while the press is held
2. The temperature moves up by more than 1 increment while the press is held
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Slider presses outside the handle are ignored
tcs.test_item: The user must press the slider handle to move the temperature slider position; if the user initially presses the slider area outside of the handle, the system shall ignore the press
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified in chapter 16 (16.2)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the slider area to the left of the slider handle
2. Press the slider handle and drag it
tcs.expected_result:
1. The temperature slider position does not move
2. The temperature slider position follows the handle
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
